text: Frege distinguished the reference (Bedeutung) of an expression from its ___ (Sinn) — its mode of presentation — which is why 'Hesperus' and 'Phosphorus' differ in cognitive value even though they name the same planet.
explanation: Frege's 'sense' (Sinn) is the mode of presentation of a referent; 'Hesperus' and 'Phosphorus' share a reference (Venus) but differ in sense, which is why 'Hesperus is Phosphorus' is informative and why attitude contexts are referentially opaque. The expected word is 'sense.'
